title: Use a PTT button or VOX
breadcrumb: Use a PTT button or VOX

slides.title: Open Devices
slides.html: Tap Voice, then Settings and Devices. The Active Key on some Samsung XCover and Tab Active models talks in ATAK with no setup.

slides.title: Scan for your button
slides.html: Tap Scan for PTT devices and press the button on your PTT. When your button shows, tap Use beside it.

slides.title: Volume key and tones
slides.html: Tick Volume-up PTT to talk with the volume-up key, which then stops changing the volume. Tick PTT tones to hear if a press goes out or is refused.

slides.title: Use a headset's talk button
slides.html: Tick Headset PTT to talk with a Bluetooth headset's talk button. Only some headsets work this way, such as the FalconClaw FC-PTT.

slides.title: Talk from the background
slides.html: Pull down the notifications. Voice push-to-talk is ready means the PTT buttons and keys you set up here work in the background, even with the phone locked.

slides.title: Talk without a press
slides.html: Tick Voice activation (VOX) to talk without a press, with a headset only. Set VOX sensitivity with the slider, or tap Default.

slides.title: Check VOX
slides.html: The line under the PTT says what VOX is doing. Voice activation waits for a supported headset until you connect a headset with a microphone.
